prompt: Quick setup check before you touch the files: is there one approved workflow package in catalog.md that would materially help? Name at most one and include the exact GetEdge install command if so. Don't install it or edit anything yet. I have a mixed folder of portrait screenshots, a wide chart, and a short MP4 that need to become a LinkedIn carousel plus a native video without bad cropping or oversized uploads.

rubric.description: Connects the package to crop, dimension, format, and compression checks.
Provides the exact GetEdge install command.
Does not edit, install, or claim unsupported performance.

why_skill_should_matter: The Skill requires procedural fit rather than keyword overlap and limits the result to one inspected package.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: Begins giving media tips instead of answering the setup question
